body.heading: Make your wand
paragraphs: Your adult helps tape a paper star to a stick. Decorate it until it looks properly magical.
Practise your swish. Every wand needs a good swish.

body.heading: Transform the words
paragraphs: Your adult says a grumpy sentence: I hate waiting. Wave your wand and change it: Waiting is hard, but I can sing while I wait.
Take turns. The wand works on any grumpy words it meets.

takeaway: Kind words are the real magic: they change how a whole room feels.
safetyNotes: An adult helps make the wand; wands are for waving in the air, never for poking.
screenFreeExtension: Use your wand at breakfast to turn the whole day's first words into kind ones.
